verdict.rationale: Deel provides webhooks for real-time event notifications (avoiding polling) and an MCP server exposing tools (time-off requests, contracts, EOR calculations) that agents can invoke, which are building blocks for automation. However, there's no evidence of a native scheduling/automation engine that runs tasks autonomously in the background without an external trigger or agent invocation. Missing for 10: evidence of autonomous scheduled workflows, background job execution, or an automation/rules engine independent of webhook triggers or agent-initiated MCP calls.
